test_title: SSC MTS 2024 Official Paper (Held On: 29 Oct, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: The average of 10 observations is 46. It was realised later that an observation was misread as 42 in place of 142. Find the correct average.
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Net difference in observations = Correct value − Wrong value = 142 − 42 = +100

Net change in average = Net difference ÷ Number of observations = 100 ÷ 10 = +10

Correct Average = Old Average + Net change = 46 + 10 = 56

**∴ The correct answer is 56.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

**Given:**

Number of observations (n) = 10

Initial average = 46

Incorrect observation = 42

Correct observation = 142

**Formula Used:**

Average = Total Sum ÷ Number of observations</
